Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Besides what I sent on Monday and the 63 pp I am sending by this days post, there are 380 pp of [the Trial](/book/53) in type in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), and in MS what I should think would make about 45 or 50 more.
I am writing to [Mrs Blackburn](/person/159) about her drawings
Yours faithfully
C. M.

Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
